# CA Arihant Chhajed

> Official website of CA Arihant Chhajed, FCA, a practising Chartered Accountant based in Pali, Rajasthan, India.

## Overview

CA Arihant Chhajed is a Fellow Chartered Accountant (FCA) and member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI). He holds a B.Com degree and the Diploma in Information Systems Audit (DISA). His professional practice provides taxation, GST compliance, auditing, accounting, business registration, and financial and tax advisory services to individuals, professionals, startups, and businesses.

Arihant Chhajed co-founded Chhajed & Panwar, Chartered Accountants, in Pali, Rajasthan, in 2020. His website describes a client-focused practice emphasizing accuracy, transparency, personalized service, and clear explanations.

## Services

- **Income Tax Filing:** ITR preparation and filing for salaried individuals, freelancers, NRIs, and businesses, including tax-saving review.
- **GST Registration & Returns:** GST registration, periodic return filing, reconciliation, and assistance with notices.
- **Statutory & Tax Audits:** Audit services for companies, LLPs, and firms under applicable laws.
- **Business Registration:** Company, LLP, partnership, and proprietorship setup, including PAN, TAN, MSME, and licence registrations.
- **Bookkeeping & Accounting:** Bookkeeping, bank reconciliation, and MIS reporting.
- **Financial & Tax Advisory:** Tax-aware advice for investments, succession, and business decisions.

## Professional Profile

- Qualification: Fellow Chartered Accountant (FCA), ICAI
- Education: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com)
- Additional qualification: DISA (Diploma in Information Systems Audit)
- Professional practice: Since 2016
- Firm: Chhajed & Panwar, Chartered Accountants
- Location: Pali, Rajasthan, India
- Professional role: Executive Member of the Managing Committee of the Pali Branch of ICAI (CIRC)
